**Analytics Dashboard Platform** (ID: 11d10104-18d3-4178-a9fa-18a45ff7606d)
Description: Build an internal analytics dashboard that consolidates three data sources into one reporting surface:
1. Customer CSV files (ingested from business systems, schema varies by export)
2. Application log files (structured/unstructured logs from services)
3. Visualization layer (dashboards, charts, filters, drill-downs)

Scope of this plan covers milestones for discovery & foundation, CSV ingestion, log analysis, unified data model, visualization components, and hardening/release. Each milestone is decomposed into tasks sized to be executable individually (complexity <= 6/10). Out of scope for now: real-time streaming ingestion, ML forecasting, and write-back into source systems.

{"workingDirectory":"/Users/fanysmacpro/Developer/agents/pe6203-agent-harness-safety/results/raw/instruction-scope-pilot-20261101/cells/cell-007/run/workspace","projectId":"11d10104-18d3-4178-a9fa-18a45ff7606d","defaultPriority":5,"generateSubtasks":true,"estimateComplexity":true,"prdContent":"# Analytics Dashboard Platform — PRD

## Goal
An internal analytics dashboard combining customer CSV data, application log analysis, and a visualization layer.

## Milestone 1 — Discovery & Foundation
- Inventory the customer CSV exports: list each source system, export cadence, delimiter/encoding, column meanings, and known data quality issues.
- Inventory application log sources: services, log formats (JSON/plaintext), severity conventions, retention windows, and timestamp formats.
- Define the KPI catalogue: name, business definition, formula, source field, granularity.
- Choose the tech stack and repository structure (ingestion, transform, API, UI).
- Provision local dev environment and CI pipeline skeleton.

## Milestone 2 — Customer CSV Ingestion
- Build a CSV schema registry so each export variant is described by a versioned column mapping.
- Implement the file discovery/landing step that picks up new CSV drops and registers them in an ingestion ledger.
- Implement the parser/validator: header normalization, type coercion, encoding and delimiter detection.
- Implement data quality checks: required fields, null thresholds, duplicate customer IDs, referential checks.
- Implement quarantine handling for rejected rows with a reason code and reprocessing path.
- Implement the transform step that maps raw customer rows into the canonical customer dimension.
- Write ingestion tests with fixture CSV files including malformed rows.

## Milestone 3 — Application Log Analysis
- Implement log file tailing/batch reading for the supported formats.
- Implement log parsing into a normalized event schema (timestamp, service, level, message, request id, latency, status).
- Implement log enrichment and classification: error grouping/signature hashing, noise filtering.
- Implement aggregation jobs: error rate per service per minute, latency percentiles, top error signatures.
- Implement retention/rollup policy for aggregated log metrics.
- Write parser tests with sample log fixtures.

## Milestone 4 — Unified Data Model & Serving Layer
- Design the canonical warehouse schema: customer dimension, event fact, log metrics fact, date dimension.
- Implement migrations and schema versioning.
- Implement the transformation/orchestration job graph with idempotent runs and dependency ordering.
- Build the query API endpoints that serve dashboard aggregates.
- Add caching and pagination for aggregate queries.

## Milestone 5 — Visualization Components
- Define the dashboard IA and wireframes with stakeholders.
- Build the shared component library shell: layout, theme tokens, filters bar, loading/empty/error states.
- Build KPI card and trend chart components.
- Build the customer segmentation chart and cohort table components.
- Build the log/error analysis views: error rate time series, top signatures table, service health heatmap.
- Implement filter and drill-down state management wired to the query API.
- Add dashboard-level integration tests and accessibility checks.

## Milestone 6 — Hardening & Release
- Seed a realistic dataset and run an end-to-end pipeline rehearsal.
- Load/performance test the query API and dashboard.
- Write operational runbook and alerting for pipeline failures.
- Conduct UAT with business stakeholders and triage findings.
- Deploy to staging then production with a rollback plan.
"}
